title: 10 out of 10
text: Highly recommended, an incredible visit, and above all the Palace of Charles V. What really surprised us was the tasting of the dishes; it was a spectacular meal!!!
author: Journey36686177881

title: A wonder
text: A very good experience. We were running a bit short on time and they called us to help us out. In addition to being a beautiful place, the guide, with her explanations, managed to make us admire all the details and the history of the place. A wonderful place to be able to visit at least once in a lifetime
author: aitorr180

title: A fantastic family visit
text: It was a fantastic visit with an exceptional guide, Daniel. A broad historical tour not lacking in anecdotes, legends, and humor. It lasts 3 hours, but it is worth it to get to know a place like the Alhambra in depth. It is hot in August, but there are many stops that allow you to take a break surrounded by vegetation. We went with two girls aged 8 and 10, and they made it through the whole tour, although naturally, at times, they were tired.
author: aroag671
